name: Manipulation
overview: Scripture warns believers to be vigilant against manipulation through deception and false teaching, as seen in Jesus' caution to beware of false prophets who disguise their harmful intentions (Matthew 7:15) and His admonition to guard against being deceived (Matthew 24:4). The epistles further reveal that some who appear as brethren seek to enslave believers by undermining the freedom found in Christ (Galatians 2:4), using persuasive speech to deceive the simple (Romans 16:18). Christians are therefore called to stand firm in the liberty Christ has provided and avoid being entangled again in spiritual bondage (Galatians 5:1).
